name: growth-memory
description: A local-first RookCue plugin for recording tasks, recovering work, finding experience and human-approved reviews, with agent-managed runtime setup.

interface.shortDescription: Turn AI-assisted work into recoverable project memory and reviewed personal knowledge.
interface.longDescription: Use natural language to record a task, recover previous work, find approved experience, or review a completed task. The agent checks the local runtime and prepares it after installation consent. Personal knowledge requires approval of the exact candidate.
defaultPrompt: 用 RookCue 记录这次任务。
